desc: SNAPDRAGON stage0: simple canonical olive-green dragon head, two small pale-yellow crown horns and ONE snout horn, orange jagged rear frill, ivory fangs, thin crooked olive thorny stalk and one pair of broad orange basal leaves. Keep actual mature dragon-plant identity rather than inventing a pale green chibi animal. Friendly calm warm-yellow eyes, small toothy smile.

DRAGON SNAP stage1: grown natural Snapdragon extension, broader stronger olive/yellow-green dragon jaw/head with prominent nostrils, two larger crown horns and one snout horn, bigger layered orange neck frill and a stronger crooked thorny olive stem. More overlapping orange base leaves. Friendly confident warm-yellow eyes and toothy grin. No new arms or body legs, no metal armor, no generic lizard body.

INFERNO DRAGON stage2: final natural Snapdragon evolution. Impressive broad olive-green DRAGON HEAD, larger pale-yellow crown horns and one proud snout horn, strong jaws with chunky ivory fangs. A broad layered ORANGE FIN-FRILL CROWN around BACK of head/neck, restrained darker red-orange frill edges, thicker curved thorny olive plant stalk and broad layered ORANGE base leaves. Friendly strong warm-yellow eyes and toothy grin, not evil. No floating fire mane, fire hat, gold king crown, wings, arms, legs or dragon torso; only actual plant anatomy grown stronger.
